# DUOTEK Information Technologies LLC (Duotek Group)

> Premier enterprise IT infrastructure, ELV cabling, and turnkey technology solutions provider in Dubai and the United Arab Emirates.

## About
Duotek Group is a technology solutions and IT infrastructure services provider based in the United Arab Emirates. We deliver turnkey infrastructure, certified cabling, surveillance, access control, unified communications, and bespoke digital software engineering for commercial offices, commercial fit-outs, and luxury residences.

## Core Pages & Services
- [Home](https://duotek.ae/): Overview of Duotek Group capabilities, turnkey engineering philosophy, client partnerships, and company headquarters.
- [Services Catalog](https://duotek.ae/services.html): Complete scope of enterprise IT, ELV infrastructure, and custom software development:
  - Custom Software Development Dubai (Bespoke business platforms, client portals, SaaS products, internal automation tools).
  - Mobile App Development Dubai & UAE (Native & cross-platform iOS & Android mobile applications).
  - Enterprise Web Applications & Client Portals (High-conversion web platforms, responsive dashboards, secure user auth).
  - Cloud Architecture, APIs & Microservices (REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, AWS/Cloudflare cloud deployments).
  - Systems & IoT Integration (ERP and CRM integration, automated data pipelines, bridging IoT/ELV hardware with software).
  - IT AMC (Annual Maintenance Contracts) with SLA-backed on-site emergency support.
  - Fluke-certified Structured Cabling (Cat6, Cat6A, single/multimode fiber optics).
  - Server Rack Architecture, Cable Dressing & Clean-Up (Wall-mounted & floor-standing 4U-47U).
  - IP Telephony & 3CX IP PBX Unified Communications with UAE telco SIP trunks.
  - Hikvision CCTV Surveillance Systems (SIRA-compliant, IP dome, bullet, PTZ, ColorVu).
  - Access Control & Biometric Time Attendance (Hikvision MinMoe facial recognition, RFID, magnetic locks).
  - Smart Home & Commercial Building Automation (Lighting, climate zoning, automated blinds).
  - Professional Commercial Sound & Audio Systems (Bosch & JBL commercial speakers).
  - Enterprise Hardware & Networking: Aruba Wi-Fi 6 Access Points, Cisco switches, Ubiquiti UniFi switches, Fortinet FortiGate firewalls, and DrayTek multi-WAN routers.
  - Enterprise Servers & Storage Arrays (Dell PowerEdge, HPE ProLiant, Synology NAS/SAN).
  - Corporate Email Solutions (Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, SPF/DKIM/DMARC deliverability).
  - Turnkey IT Infrastructure Relocation & Commercial Office Fit-Out Decommissioning/Recommissioning.

## Software Engineering & Digital Practice
- Core Technologies: Modern web & mobile frameworks (React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, Flutter, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker).
- Target Markets: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and across the UAE & GCC.
- Delivery Model: Agile sprints, rapid prototyping, turnkey cloud deployment, and long-term SLA maintenance.

- [About Us](https://duotek.ae/about.html): Company history, mission, vision, certified engineering team, client portfolio (Aegon Shipping, Regale Innovation Polyclinic, Don Padel, Prompt Interiors), and disciplined 6-stage project execution framework.
- [Contact Us](https://duotek.ae/contact.html): Office address, direct phone, email, and inquiry form for software project proposals, site surveys, and technical quotations.
